items.q: How much does it cost me to sell tickets?
items.a: A commission per managed sale: 5% + VAT + payment gateway (~9.1% all-in), deducted from your settlement. Attendees pay the exact price; cash door sales carry no commission.

items.q: Do I need a plan to sell?
items.a: No. You can publish your event and sell tickets anytime. A plan adds multi-staff, analytics, CRM and marketing campaigns.

items.q: When do I get my sales money?
items.a: When the event closes, the settlement is ready with the commission already deducted; payout follows the configured cycle.

items.q: Does my audience need to install an app?
items.a: No. They buy on the web, get a QR ticket, and you or your staff validate it at the door from a phone.
Yes, monthly anytime; semiannual and annual run to the end of the period with their discount.
